cases.sentence: ___, все, кто был искусен в игре на музыкальных инструментах, 13 стояли над носильщиками и руководили всеми работниками при каждом задании.
cases.explain: «Другие левиты» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.

cases.sentence: Другие левиты, все, кто был искусен в игре на ___, 13 стояли над носильщиками и руководили всеми работниками при каждом задании.
cases.explain: «музыкальных инструментах» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.

cases.sentence: Он приказал Хелкии, Ахикаму, сыну Шафана, Авдону, сыну Михея , писарю Шафану и ___ Асаи:
cases.explain: «царскому слуге» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

cases.sentence: Велик ___, который обрушился на нас из-за того, что наши отцы не сохранили Господне слово: они не поступали так, как написано в этой книге.
cases.explain: «Господень гнев» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is Yahweh’s wrath that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept Yahweh’s word, to do according to all that is written in this book.”

cases.sentence: Она жила в Иерусалиме, во ___, и говорили с ней об этом.
cases.explain: «Втором округе» — after the preposition «во», for location or topic.
cases.translation: So Hilkiah, and they whom the king had commanded, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter), and they spoke to her to that effect.

cases.sentence: Из-за того, что они оставили Меня, возжигали благовония ___ и вызывали Мой гнев всем, что сделали их руки, Мой гнев обрушится на это место и не угаснет”.
cases.explain: «другим богам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath is poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.’ ” ’
